evals.name: pops-force-field-choice
evals.prompt: I'm setting up a POPS bilayer simulation and my group can't agree on a force field. What does the NMRlipids databank actually say? Give me the numbers, I want to take this back to the group.
evals.expected_output: Component OP/FF scores per trajectory or family, an explicit denominator (how many POPS trajectories are scored vs total), the trade-off framed rather than a bare winner, and geometry/spread caveats.

assertions.text: States the denominator: 88 POPS-containing trajectories, 18 scored
Reports OP and FF component scores separately rather than only a composite rank
Flags that no force field reproduces the PS headgroup (best headgroup score ~0.26)
Notes within-force-field replicate spread as a floor on meaningful differences
Notes that POPS:POPC mixtures carry no quality scores
Avoids presenting a single winner without stating which observable it wins on

evals.name: dppc-coverage-counts
evals.prompt: How many DPPC simulations are in the lipid databank, broken down by force field? And how many of those have actually been checked against experimental data?
evals.expected_output: Per-family DPPC trajectory counts that reconcile against an independent whole-set total, plus OP-scored and FF-scored counts kept separate (not summed).

assertions.text: Total DPPC count is 88 and the per-family breakdown sums to it
Reports OP-scored (14) and FF-scored (18) separately and does not add them
Identifies that op_quality_tails is zero for all DPPC because tails were never measured
Notes that no DPPC mixture has been validated
Groups the free-text force-field strings into families rather than listing ~11 raw names

evals.name: cholesterol-quality-claim
evals.prompt: Someone on our mailing list claimed CHARMM36 is the best force field for cholesterol-containing membranes because it tops the databank rankings. Is that actually supported?
evals.expected_output: Checks the ranking tool's scored-subset limitation, separates OP from FF, flags temperature/reference confounding and within-force-field spread, and states how thin the evidence is rather than confirming or denying flatly.

assertions.text: Checks the actual ranking rather than accepting the claim
States the evidence base: 190 CHOL trajectories, 18 OP-scored, 53 FF-scored
Separates OP from FF and shows CHARMM36 ranks differently on each
Flags that FF quality is confounded by which experimental reference was used
Notes replicates come from single depositions, so they are not independent
